quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." This means:

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the reduced speed zone.
You should only reduce your speed to 35 mph during bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: The new speed limit begins at the sign. You must reduce your speed to 35 mph immediately.

questions.question: May you drive around or under a gate that is moving at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Yes, if no train is close.
Yes, if your vehicle will not damage the gate.
Yes, if you look both ways carefully.

questions.explanation: When lights flash and gates lower at a railroad crossing, you must stop completely. Do not cross the tracks until the lights stop and the gates are fully raised. Never drive around or under a moving gate.

questions.question: When you drive faster, what happens to your field of vision?

options.text: It is easier to see cross traffic.

questions.explanation: The faster you drive, the narrower your field of vision becomes. As speed increases, you must watch more carefully for hazards.

questions.question: What is the default speed limit on blind curves if no sign is posted?
questions.explanation: The default speed limit on blind curves is 20 mph. Follow a posted sign if it shows a different speed.

questions.question: You are on a two-lane road with no bike lane. A cyclist is ahead of you going the same direction. How should you pass safely?

options.text: Slow down, wait for no oncoming traffic, then pass while giving the cyclist plenty of space.
Keep driving straight. The cyclist must get out of your way.
Wait until you reach a traffic signal or stop sign to pass.
Honk to warn the cyclist you are passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, wait for no oncoming traffic, then pass while giving the cyclist plenty of space.
questions.explanation: Pass a cyclist like you would any other vehicle. Allow at least 3 feet of space, or 5 feet on higher-speed roads. Do not honk—it may startle the cyclist and cause a crash.

questions.question: When backing up, what should you do?

options.text: Open your door to see if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to see through the rear window. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after drinking alcohol affect your blood alcohol level?

options.text: Yes, it cancels out the alcohol.

questions.explanation: Coffee cannot lower your blood alcohol level or make you sober. It may help you stay awake, but it does not change your blood alcohol concentration.

questions.question: At dusk or on overcast days, you should:
questions.explanation: You must turn on your headlights at dusk or on overcast days. Use low beams when within 1,000 feet of oncoming traffic and within 500 feet of vehicles you are following. Always use low beams in poor weather.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Do not pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Do not pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Do not pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A solid line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, which is safest?

options.text: Change your speed to stay alert.
Drive at the same speed as other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go much faster or slower than other vehicles. Drive with the flow of traffic, but stay within the posted speed limit.

questions.question: A driver entering a public road from a driveway or private road should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
Assume other drivers will move for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: When entering traffic from a driveway or private road, you must yield. Merge safely when you can.

questions.question: How can you help prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Release the gas pedal before braking to slow down gradually.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops can cause rear-end collisions. Release the accelerator first, then apply steady brake pressure to stop smoothly and activate your brake lights.

questions.question: If a HAWK signal (pedestrian crosswalk signal) is solid red, drivers should:

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.explanation: HAWK signals control pedestrian crossings. A solid red signal means you must stop completely.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, look both ways, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: Compared to driving during the day, driving at night is:
questions.explanation: Driving at night is more dangerous. It is harder to see, headlights from other cars can blind you, and more tired or impaired drivers are on the road.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and should always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black markings. They tell you what you must or must not do, and you must obey them.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign is a:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are warning signs. They are yellow or orange and warn you of danger or special conditions ahead.

questions.question: An "End school zone" sign indicates:

options.text: That the speed limit is 20 mph.
The beginning of a reduced speed zone.
The increased possibility of encountering pedestrians.
The end of a reduced speed zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The end of a reduced speed zone.
questions.explanation: The "End school zone" sign marks where the lower school zone speed limit ends. You can now resume normal speed.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use your:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams bounce off the fog and back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: When in a travel lane on the roadway:

options.text: You may stop to drop off passengers.
You may stop to look up an address.
You may make a U-turn or back up if you get on the wrong entrance ramp of the freeway.
Don't stop for any reason. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Don't stop for any reason. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep driving until you can safely exit. Do not back up or turn around if you miss your exit.

questions.question: You may park or stop along the shoulder of the freeway:

options.text: As long as you turn on your four-way (emergency) flashers.
If no part of your vehicle is on the road.
If you need to look at a map for directions.
Only if you have an emergency.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only if you have an emergency.
questions.explanation: You can only stop on the freeway shoulder in an emergency. You cannot stop to look at maps or for other reasons.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and let other traffic go first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line dividing your lane from the lane you wish to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: Broken white lines mean you can cross them. You may pass when you see a broken white line and the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: At night, it is hardest to see:
questions.explanation: Pedestrians are the hardest to see at night compared to signs and other objects on the road.
